scope: One static cross-source implementation and verifier review; acceptance is source-level and is neither activation authorization nor a quality/deployment result.
implementation_findings: Initial response graph is frozen before export; each arm strictly reloads its own complete mixed-dtype package from a meta graph before its 100 initial DEV generations.

Original BudgetQV initialization freezes parameters, after which make_wide explicitly restores all 24 FP32 beta flags and asserts the exact 96 A/B plus 24 beta mask: 120 tensors, 4399128 coordinates and 17596512 gradient bytes.

The original stage-loop AST retains its GradScaler, stage-reset schedule, accumulation and 87-update recipe. The temporary optimizer holder supports stage receipts after the AST deletes its optimizer name; each saved optimizer payload is checked on GPU.

Both arms retain the explicit signed-Down branch. Q/V merging uses GPU FP32 with autocast and TF32 disabled; static gamma absorbs the calibration once, removes the 24 calibration buffers and binds the effective coefficient digest before complete export.

Complete state and all named buffers preserve exact aliases for I/O. Reload restores mixed parameter dtypes, explicit buffers, default original_inv_freq aliases, tied language weights and the registered bridge newline alias before receipt comparison.

Final evaluation runs in separate fresh processes, with five fixed 32-token resource windows before 100 final DEV generations. Both final evaluations use the same declared GPU and bind raw input, transport, shapes and generation lengths.

Controller and verifier agree on four phase limits totaling 8400 model seconds, 2426 FIT backwards, 174 updates, 410 generated requests and exactly 400 new Answer-F1 scoring calls after all successful exits.

Verifier checks original worker PID/startticks no longer present, source/runtime/prior/file receipts, deterministic FIT orders, exactly 19 stage receipts and adapter files, 87 events and gradient receipts, full package/reload receipts, scalar compilation, initial arm output-token agreement and post-evaluation state/buffer invariance before creating VERIFY_STARTED. New scores use the sealed historical per-ID order without recomputing historical scores.
interpretation_limits: initial_invariant proves state and registered buffers unchanged across initial readout. It is not a separate actual base-model forward/output equivalence check. Finite beta-zero path preservation is supported by the response arithmetic; the verifier additionally compares both arms' actual initial token outputs.

Static S1 RMS calibration matches gate amplitude only; it does not match response or gradient magnitude, sign, covariance or future-domain statistics. The pair identifies the declared complete interventions, not a uniquely isolated causal effect of input dependence.

Historical wide-QV quality is copied from sealed proof as an exploratory per-domain screening floor. There is no matched QV-only arm, no new strong-PAS resource measurement and no formal superiority result in this implementation.

Final parameter design is 893675552 FP16 base coefficients plus 24 FP32 scalars, giving 893675576 coefficients and 1787351200 bytes. The 233472-byte sign buffers and initial-static 96-byte calibration buffers are counted separately. No reduction versus plain folded wide-QV/OSFT is claimed.
Single-seed, repeatedly explored 100-DEV results must report all five domains and cannot establish significance, equivalence or noninferiority.
cost_disclosure: The completed 32-NLL calibration diagnostic and 768 sampled extra Down calls are historical shared costs, separate from these phase budgets.

Complete initial/final checkpoints are hashed by export and again by phase file receipts; verifier also checks the recorded file chain. This implementation is not described as hashing each checkpoint only once. All phase work remains inside the unchanged limits.
